SOUTH EAST

2026-10-31
Preamble: Wind and wave forecasts are averages. Wind gusts can be 40 per cent stronger than the forecast, and stronger still in squalls and thunderstorms. Maximum waves can be twice the forecast height.
Synoptic situation: A cold front moving across Tasmania on Saturday afternoon will clear to the east on Sunday, followed by a weak ridge of high pressure later Sunday. A low pressure system is forecast to move across Victoria during Monday then over the Tasman Sea on Tuesday. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west on Wednesday.
